channel.title: reranker.uk changelog
channel.description: Release notes for reranker.uk — demo features, guides, and site improvements.

item.title: 24 Oct 2026 — A faster ms-marco MiniLM
item.description: The scenario guide now mentions cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L4-v2, the faster four-layer sibling of the MiniLM-L6 model in our demo, with sentence-transformers' own quality and speed figures.

item.title: 23 Oct 2026 — NVIDIA Nemotron rerankers
item.description: A new page for NVIDIA's rerankers: Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B for text and page images, with NVIDIA's scores and whose they are, plus the llama-nemotron vision-language and text models. Two new rows in the models table.

item.title: 22 Oct 2026 — Cohere Rerank 5 prices
item.description: Cohere priced Rerank 5 per token ($0.05 per million for Pro, $0.02 for Fast) and took Rerank 4 off its pricing page. Both are on the site and in the cost calculator, Rerank 4 marked as last listed.

item.title: 21 Oct 2026 — Cohere Rerank 5
item.description: Cohere released Rerank 5 (Pro and Fast) with calibrated scores and Context Focus. Prices aren't published yet; the site says so and watches Cohere's pricing page for them.

item.title: 16 Oct 2026 (evening) — Pages for LightOn-rerank, GTE and Contextual AI
item.description: New model pages for LightOn-rerank, Alibaba's GTE rerankers and Contextual AI Rerank v2; zerank-2 and Qwen3-VL-Reranker join the homepage cards.

item.title: 16 Oct 2026 (afternoon) — Contextual AI’s hosted API
item.description: Contextual AI's hosted rerank API, the commercial route to its non-commercial v2 weights, joins the models table, the scenario and instruction guides, and the cost calculator.

item.title: 16 Oct 2026 (later) — Three more options in the cost calculator
item.description: The cost calculator adds ZeroEntropy zerank-2, Amazon Rerank 1.0 on Bedrock and Pinecone's own rerankers, and says why Cohere on Bedrock and on Pinecone are left out.

item.title: 16 Oct 2026 — Pinecone and Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock and Pinecone join the models table, and the vector database guide gains a worked Pinecone example. All 13 new prices and limits are checked daily.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (last) — A shorter changelog
item.description: The changelog page now shows the ten newest entries and folds earlier ones by month. Links to an older entry, including the ones in this feed, open its month.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (late) — Previous and next on the reading path
item.description: The five reading-path guides now end with links to the guide before and after, and show which step of five you're on.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 — Pages for zerank-2 and Qwen3-VL-Reranker
item.description: New model pages: zerank-2 (its licence conflict, ZeroEntropy's scores against Cohere rerank-3.5, API pricing) and Qwen3-VL-Reranker (page images, screenshots and video). All 46 new figures are checked daily.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 — Pages load faster on a repeat visit
item.description: Stylesheet and script addresses now carry a fingerprint of their contents, so browsers keep them for a year instead of re-checking them on every page view.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (late night) — The privacy page names the analytics it runs
item.description: The privacy page said the site ran no analytics; it runs Cloudflare Web Analytics. The page now says so, with what Cloudflare documents about it: no cookies, no fingerprinting, no personal data, no query strings.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (night) — The security policy now blocks, not just reports
item.description: The Content-Security-Policy added on 27 Sep now blocks instead of only reporting, after clean daily runs and a check from mainland China. A new daily test loads every live page and fails on any violation.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (evening) — Light or dark, as your system is set
item.description: Until you use the theme switch, the site now follows your system's light or dark setting instead of always opening dark. A choice made with the switch still wins.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 (later) — Search the site
item.description: A search button in the header, or / on any page, finds guides and model pages by title, headings and description. It runs in the browser, searches the pages in your language, and works from the keyboard alone.

item.title: 15 Oct 2026 — Guides in reading order; text no longer touches the screen edge on phones
item.description: The guides page now starts with five guides in reading order, then the pages for specific jobs. On phones, every guide and model page had lost its side margins; they are back, and a test checks every page at phone width.

item.title: 14 Oct 2026 (late night) — The models table keeps its first column on a phone
item.description: On a phone, the models table now keeps the model name and the column headings in view while you scroll sideways. Sections on the homepage, changelog and demo get their side margins back on phones.

item.title: 14 Oct 2026 (night) — Homepage diagram corrected; shortcuts for the job in front of you
item.description: The homepage pipeline diagram had the candidate counts on the wrong arrows. It now shows the retriever returning 50–100 candidates and the reranker keeping the top 5, and it stacks on a phone. The homepage also links the scenario guide, the mainland-China guide, the cost calculator, and the “reranking didn't help” page.

item.title: 14 Oct 2026 (later) — Every page has its own preview card
item.description: Links shared to WeChat, X or Slack now show a card with the page's own title, description and section, in English or Chinese to match the page, instead of one site-wide cover.

item.title: 14 Oct 2026 — New guide: reranking in mainland China
item.description: A guide for readers whose servers are in mainland China: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, SiliconFlow or self-hosting, with prices in yuan, Chinese retrieval scores, working code, and downloading weights through hf-mirror.com or ModelScope.

item.title: 12 Oct 2026 (later) — Every benchmark figure is now checked daily; Mixedbread v1 figures corrected
item.description: About 70 benchmark figures that were typed into the Jina, Qwen, Mixedbread and models pages are now read from each vendor's model card and checked daily. The Mixedbread page's untraceable v1 BEIR and MS MARCO figures are replaced by the numbers on Mixedbread's own model cards.

item.title: 12 Oct 2026 — Older guides brought up to date; framework code re-run
item.description: The scenario guide drops two Voyage models that don't exist and adds Chinese/multilingual and scanned-document sections. The RAG guide's LangChain and Haystack examples failed on current releases; they are fixed and were re-run on LangChain 1.4, LlamaIndex 0.14 and Haystack 3.3. The self-hosting, instruction and troubleshooting guides are updated to current models.

item.title: 9 Oct 2026 (night) — The cost calculator covers Google, Alibaba Cloud and SiliconFlow
item.description: The rerank cost calculator adds Google Vertex AI ranking and Alibaba Cloud's international qwen3-rerank to its dollar table, and a new yuan table for Alibaba Cloud's Beijing region and SiliconFlow, with the same daily-checked prices as the models table.

item.title: 9 Oct 2026 (evening) — Alibaba Cloud, SiliconFlow and Google's ranking API in the models table
item.description: The models table adds three hosted reranker APIs: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, qwen3-vl-rerank), SiliconFlow (hosted bge-reranker-v2-m3 and Qwen3-Reranker) and Google Vertex AI ranking, with prices checked daily against each vendor's price page.

item.title: 9 Oct 2026 (later) — Hosted rerankers watched too; Mixedbread's new listwise model
item.description: The daily release check now reads the model lists of nine more hosted-reranker vendors, including Alibaba Cloud and SiliconFlow. Mixedbread now treats v1 and v2 as legacy and reranks with mxbai-rerank-v3.1-listwise inside Mixedbread Search; the Mixedbread page covers it. The models table notes zerank-2's licence conflict and NVIDIA's 500M reranker.

item.title: 9 Oct 2026 — Three rerankers the release watch had missed; ColBERT through sentence-transformers
item.description: The daily release watch now checks every model Hugging Face tags as a reranker, popular ones the site never mentioned, and the libraries the demo and guides use. Qwen3-VL-Reranker, zerank-2 and gte-multilingual-reranker-base join the models table; CLM-v0.1-8B is explained rather than added; the ColBERT example now runs on sentence-transformers 6.

item.title: 5 Oct 2026 — Voyage rerank-3, what changed; LightOn-rerank added
item.description: Voyage's rerank-3 announcement confirms the Rerank 3 series keeps natural-language instructions; the Voyage page now covers what changed, with figures checked daily. LightOn-rerank, an Apache 2.0 text-and-image reranker family, joins the models table. A daily watch now looks for new reranker releases.

item.title: 3 Oct 2026 — The RAG guide's model picks, corrected; the Chinese pages, finished
item.description: The RAG guide's model recommendations called bge-reranker-v2-m3 English-only and pointed at Cohere Rerank v3.5 and Voyage Rerank 2; they now match the model pages. Remaining English on the Chinese pages — tables of contents, a diagram, table source notes, demo hints — is translated.

item.title: 2 Oct 2026 — Structured data that matches the page
item.description: Five pages carried hidden FAQ markup that still repeated claims the site had withdrawn; it's removed. Structured data on every page, including the Chinese ones, is now generated from the page's own title and description, and a CI check keeps it that way.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — The demo recovers when the mirror can’t serve
item.description: If hf-mirror.com wins the demo's host race but can't serve the files (outside mainland China it redirects to huggingface.co without CORS headers), the demo now retries once on the other host. The daily real-network check covers that path, and every page is now checked for CSP violations in CI.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — The demo scores about twice as fast
item.description: The demo pages are now cross-origin isolated, so ONNX Runtime Web scores on several threads: about 1.9x faster in a same-machine A/B. Isolation and a blob:-permitting CSP apply to the demo pages only, and a daily check confirms the live headers.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Latency figures measured, or sourced, or gone
item.description: The browser demo's three models are now measured on a GitHub runner (about 0.4–1.4 s for 10 passages, not the 30–150 ms the site claimed), and two of the demo's download sizes are corrected. mixedbread's and Jina's published latencies are cited; unsourced CPU/GPU figures are removed.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Qwen3, Contextual AI, GTE and NVIDIA rows checked against their model cards
item.description: Contextual AI Rerank v2 is open-weight (non-commercial) and multilingual, not an English-only API. Unsourced Hit@1 figures for NVIDIA and GTE removed; GTE shows Alibaba's 56.19 BEIR. Qwen3 rows show Qwen's own MTEB-R, the 4B-vs-8B claim is corrected, and the Qwen page gains Qwen's full score table and instruction usage.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Cohere's 500-token rule, and Voyage rerank-3
item.description: Correction: Cohere does bill documents over 500 tokens as several, per its own pricing FAQ — this site said otherwise in September, and the cost calculator now models it. Voyage rerank-3 is now Voyage's recommended reranker, not a preview. Cohere and Voyage prices are sourced in data/models.json and checked daily.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — jina-reranker-v3.5, and Jina's licences spelled out
item.description: jina-reranker-v3.5 added (0.6B listwise, 63.20 BEIR in Jina's own test). Jina's v2, v3, v3.5 and m0 weights are now labelled CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial. "Jina v3 beats Qwen3-Reranker-4B" withdrawn after Jina's own 2026 re-run, and unsourced Jina prices removed.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — bge-reranker's BEIR figure, and a daily check on every source
item.description: bge-reranker-v2-m3 corrected from an untraceable ~60.1 to BAAI's own 55.36, and the bge page's benchmark table rebuilt from what BAAI published. Jina v1 tiny and ms-marco MiniLM-L6 now show Jina's published BEIR figures. The footnote no longer claims a common BEIR protocol, and a daily job re-checks every figure against its source.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — An accessibility pass, and a check to keep it
item.description: Links in running text are underlined, five low-contrast text colours fixed, wide code blocks keyboard-scrollable. Every build now runs axe-core's WCAG 2.1 AA rules on all 48 pages in both themes: over 400 issues on the first run, none now.

item.title: 28 Sep 2026 — transformers.js 4.3.0, and what report-only caught
item.description: The demo moves to transformers.js 4.3.0, verified on all three demo models against live infrastructure. The report-only CSP's first real run caught HuggingFace's CDN redirects and transformers.js 4's blob: import, both fixed before the policy is ever enforced.

item.title: 27 Sep 2026 — Security headers, report-only for now
item.description: Added public/_headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and a report-only CSP), generated at build time with a script-src hash computed from the site's one inline script. Both smoke tests now assert zero CSP violations.

item.title: 26 Sep 2026 — ms-marco MiniLM's BEIR figure was never published
item.description: ms-marco MiniLM-L6 now reads "not published" in the model comparison table — sentence-transformers' own docs report TREC DL 19 NDCG@10, not a BEIR average, so the ~55.0 this table carried had no source.

item.title: 26 Sep 2026 — mxbai-rerank-v2, a corrected BEIR figure, and a demo smoke test
item.description: mxbai-rerank-large-v1's BEIR figure corrected from an unsourced ~62.1 to mixedbread's own 49.32; mxbai-rerank-v2 (multilingual, incl. Chinese) added to the table; benchmark facts now live in a sourced data/models.json; a Playwright smoke test now covers the live demo.

item.title: 18 Sep 2026 — URLs without the .html, and two pricing corrections
item.description: Internal URLs dropped .html; Voyage's free-token grant moved to rerank-3, added to the table and calculator; a token-formula bug and a Cohere chunking myth both corrected; homepage diagram translated; model table made screen-reader friendly.

item.title: 25 Aug 2026 — Two guides for the questions people actually ask
item.description: New troubleshooting guide for rerankers that show no lift, and a guide to wiring a rerank stage onto pgvector, Qdrant or Elasticsearch. Plus a generated /llms.txt and sitewide RSS autodiscovery.

item.title: 14 Aug 2026 — Cost calculator, and demo links that land somewhere
item.description: New rerank cost calculator comparing Cohere per-search and Voyage per-token billing; demo links across every guide now open the relevant scenario via ?s=.

item.title: 11 Aug 2026 — Real Chinese URLs, and a 2026 model refresh
item.description: Chinese pre-rendered at /zh/ with real hreflang; generated sitemap; Cohere Rerank 4, Voyage rerank-2.5, Jina v3 BEIR 61.94; design refresh.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Model landscape refresh
item.description: Qwen3 family + deep page; Jina v3 listwise; GTE ModernBERT; NVIDIA; honest score footnotes.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Minimal polish pack
item.description: Honest benchmarks; demo max_length; lazy transformers.js; instruction-rerank guide; homepage beyond five families.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Content expansion & polish
item.description: Architecture column on models table; Qwen3, Contextual AI, ColBERT rows; late-interaction guide; 7 demo presets; JSON-LD inLanguage; changelog RSS.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — i18n & SEO completion
item.description: Model page i18n gaps; changelog & privacy Chinese; hreflang tags; og:locale:alternate.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Low-priority polish
item.description: Guide i18n; gzip share links; preset mobile layout; dual-diff a11y.
